'''Riyl Shades''' lurk behind the steel door in the [[Shade Catacombs]] in [[Mort'ton]]. They initially appear as dark reddish moving shadows, known as Riyl Shadows, on the ground and then rise from the depths to attack or retaliate. Their [[Riyl remains|remains]] can be cremated with [[Willow pyre logs|willow]] or higher tier [[pyre logs]]. The [[salve amulet]] and [[salve amulet (e)]] work well on this shade which is very useful if shades are assigned for a [[slayer assignment]].

In the [[Temple Trekking]] minigame, these shades are called Riyl shadows, despite already being in their shade form when encountered.
